title: spec: Add per-peer rate limit for DIO/DAO processing
description:
Trickle limits outbound but no receiver-side rate limit. Verifies every inbound signature without budget.

Fix: Add to 05-routing.md Section 8:
'Receivers MUST rate-limit RPL control message processing to at most 30 messages per minute per source IID.'

Ref: worker6-h4pl
